capabilities: Shift embedded note headings to match the parent note's heading hierarchy
Show embedded headings in the Outline view and the metadata cache
Navigate from outline entries to the exact rendered heading
Hide embed line, indentation, filename, scrollbar, and height limit via CSS settings
Align PDF bookmarks with the shifted outline when exporting
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later; Outline support relies on internal Obsidian APIs that may change in future versions. The plugin writes no note files and makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: Show embedded headings in Obsidian's built-in Outline view, at their shifted levels
problem: Obsidian renders embedded notes with their original heading levels and separate embed styling, so transcluded content breaks the parent note's heading hierarchy and outline.

relations.evidence: Keep the PDF bookmarks created by Better Export PDF aligned with the Obsidian outline
Expose embedded headings to metadata-cache-based outline and search plugins, including Quiet Outline, Subtle TOC
Quiet Outline and Subtle TOC also show the embedded headings
heading search commands such as Another Quick Switcher's Header search in file

summary: Renders embedded notes as part of the containing note by shifting their heading levels, adding them to the outline, and hiding embed chrome.
